rationale: ATLL is a systemic HTLV-1-associated mature T-cell neoplasm involving blood/marrow, lymph nodes, skin, liver, lung and spleen; it is not confined to a proper subset (CNS-only or marrow-only) of its bone-marrow+CNS ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: HTLV-1-positive designation is an etiologic qualifier of the same systemic disease; involvement spans multiple organs and is not restricted to a proper subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Etiologic qualifier for the same systemic ATLL entity; not anatomically restricted to a subset of the bone-marrow+CNS ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Synonym for the systemic ATLL entity; disseminated disease not confined to a proper subset of ceiling sites.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Synonym for the systemic ATLL entity; no anatomic restriction to a subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Acute Shimoyama subtype is defined by leukemic presentation, systemic symptoms, hypercalcemia and high LDH, not by restriction to a specific anatomic subset; may involve CNS and marrow among other organs but is systemic.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Chronic Shimoyama subtype is defined by lymphocytosis and skin/lung/liver involvement with normal LDH/calcium; it is a systemic clinical variant, not restricted to a proper subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Lymphomatous Shimoyama subtype presents with lymphadenopathy/organomegaly and <1% circulating cells; systemic distribution, not confined to a subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Lymphomatous subtype synonym; a systemic clinical variant defined by lymphomatous presentation, not by anatomic restriction to a subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Smoldering Shimoyama subtype presents with lung or skin involvement and normal counts; an indolent systemic clinical variant, not restricted to a proper subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Chronic clinical variant of systemic ATLL; defined by hematologic/organ criteria (skin, lung, liver, lymphocytosis), not anatomically confined to a subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Cutaneous-type ATLL is skin-predominant, but skin (C44*) is not within this term's ceiling of bone marrow (C421) and CNS (C728/C729); within the ceiling it is not restricted to a CNS-only or marrow-only subset, so no valid proper subset applies.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Lymphomatous clinical variant of systemic ATLL; multiorgan lymphomatous presentation, not confined to a proper subset of the bone-marrow+CNS ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)

rationale: Smoldering clinical variant of systemic ATLL defined by indolent hematologic/organ criteria; not restricted to a proper subset of the ceiling.
source_name: StatPearls, Adult T-Cell Leukemia (NCBI Bookshelf NBK558968)
